messages:
sam: Quick sync We had a near-miss: policy picked a cheaper same-region variant that later spiked to p99>1s. Need a lightweight, practical signal contract.

maya: Agreed. Proposal: three canonical fields on route descriptors: runtime.capacity_score (0-1), runtime.probe_p99_ms (short-window), runtime.signal_ts. Missing -> conservative defaults.

alex: Important: staleness handling. If signal_ts older than 12s, age capacity_score toward 0.2. Stale probes hide hot GPUs during bursts.

eli: Implementation preference: compiler adapter that normalizes per-runtime payloads to canonical names so we can ship without changing all runtimes. Adapter can contain per-runtime mappers.
jordan: Policy sketch: prefer same-region if capacity_score>=0.6 && probe_p99_ms<=300; else if capacity_score>=0.4 && cost_delta<=0.15 allow cost; else hedge N=1 preferring latency up to cost_cap=0.25.
rachel: Console: show normalized signal + raw metric and a simulated decision preview; expose per-tenant opt-in for hedging with an estimated egress delta.
sam: Backcompat: runtimes without fields get capacity_score=0.33, probe_p99_ms=9999, signal_ts=now-60s -> conservative behavior. Document in SDK.

eli: Testing: sim suites for (A) stale-probe, (B) sudden p99 spike with cost gap, (C) gradual egress. Metrics: request latency, hedge_count, per-tenant egress delta. I'll run a 30d sim once adapter mapping exists.
jordan: Ops-bot: create alerts for region.capacity_drop (30% drop), routing.hedge_spike.

ops-bot: @jordan created alert: "region.capacity_drop" threshold=30% window=60s. Runbook: regional-capacity playbook; temporary hedging override.

alex: Actions: eli -> mapping doc + adapter heuristics (ETA Wed); sam -> unit tests + sim harness PR (ETA Thu); maya -> RFC follow-up + rollout note (ETA Tue); rachel -> console preview mock + opt-in copy (ETA Mon). Keep hedging opt-in while sims validate.

maya: One tradeoff: hedging increases cross-region egress. Optimize team must provide per-tenant sim and a guardrail opt-out.

sam: Sounds good. I'll open the follow-up RFC PR with these decisions and the sim plan.

eli: +1

rachel: :thumbsup:

alex: Thanks all.
